name: Selfheal
desc: Selfheal (Prunella vulgaris): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Prunella vulgaris, the common self-heal, heal-all, woundwort, heart-of-the-earth, carpenter's herb, brownwort or blue curls, is an herbaceous flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae).
